subject: Streaming SDK intermittent stalls impacting checkout throughput
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@pegasus-retail.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Zhao <ben.zhao@pegasus-retail.com>
Date: 2028-09-15T08:22:10Z
Subject: Checkout latency spike + 502s during peak — immediate help needed

Hi Sean —

We're seeing a serious regression in checkout throughput starting yesterday afternoon. At peak our p99 latency jumped from ~240ms to 2.8s and we've observed transient 502/504 responses that are taking down some checkout flows. This started after we upgraded to Redwood client SDK v1.12.3 (streaming enabled by default). Our engineering team captured live har traces and server-side traces that show repeated stream-parser errors and header reassembly failures in the gateway logs.

This is impacting a high-volume promotion window for us — we need an urgent triage and a temporary mitigation we can apply this evening. Please escalate to engineering and let us know immediate next steps.

Attachments: peg-har-20280915.zip (HAR export), gateway-errors-20280915.log

Thanks,
Elena
VP, Engineering
Pegasus Retail
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@pegasus-retail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, EdgeWorks Support <support@edgeworks.io>
Date: 2028-09-15T09:03:45Z
Subject: Re: Checkout latency spike + 502s during peak — immediate help needed

Elena —

Thanks for the heads up and the artifacts. I'm sorry you're seeing this during a promo — we take these incidents seriously. I've looped in Marissa (AM) and Priyom (engineering on the streaming runtime). EdgeWorks support is copied to correlate any gateway-side issues on their adapter.

Immediate asks: can you confirm the SDK version and whether you last toggled streaming on the client side or if this shipped via a server-side flag? Also please upload the HAR and the gateway error logs to the link below (or reply with the attachments).

I'll coordinate an on-call triage now and propose a short mitigation: 1) flip client to non-streaming (polling) for checkout traffic, or 2) add an edge rule to route checkout traffic to a non-streaming model variant. Either should reduce parser pressure.

I'm available for a quick call in 20 minutes — Marissa, Priyom, can you join?

Sean 
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, EdgeWorks Support <support@edgeworks.io>
Date: 2028-09-15T10:18:02Z
Subject: Re: Checkout latency spike + 502s during peak — immediate help needed

Quick triage notes from the on-call review:

- Root symptom: client-side streaming frames arriving with fragmented header blocks; our streaming parser (v1.12.3 runtime path) mishandles certain header-chunk ordering when frames split mid-header under high concurrency. This leads to a parser back-off state that blocks that connection's KV cache and causes cascading p99 increase.
- Repro: reproduced in lab with a simulated client that intentionally fragments header frames; see attached perf-traces-pegasus-20280915.json and a narrow HAR snippet (in the ZIP Elena attached).
- Short-term mitigations we can apply tonight (ordered by speed):
  1) Instruct clients to disable streaming for checkout (SDK flag: streaming=false). Quick, no infra deploy.
  2) On Redwood side push a routing rule to route /checkout -> model-variant-nonstream for Pegasus account. Requires a config change but no code.
  3) EdgeWorks: add a small reassembly buffer to avoid splitting header blocks (they indicated a 2-3 hour patch possible).

I'll prepare a small patch to make the parser more robust (v1.12.4) but that will need regression testing; target ETA: 48-72 hours.

Attachments: perf-traces-pegasus-20280915.json

Priyom
Senior Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-09-16T14:05:10Z
Subject: Fwd: customer escalation — Pegasus promotion window (need exec update)

Folks —

This has attracted VP-level attention at Pegasus and they've looped in their CTO. They want an exec summary and a timeline for the fix + compensation options. We should own the narrative.

Please prepare by EOD tomorrow:
- A one-pager (1x slide or doc) that explains cause, short-term mitigation we've applied, and timeline for a patch.
- Proposed credit/discount (Marissa to lead on commercial) — baseline suggestion 30% of this week's usage for impacted routes; open to negotiation.
- A customer-ready mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones and responsibilities.

Grace: can CS own the MAP and coordinate the follow-up call? Priyom: ETA on the patch and a safe rollback plan? Sean: I'll take point on the customer exec update and coordinate the call.

Marissa
Account Director
Redwood Inference
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@pegasus-retail.com>, Ben Zhao <ben.zhao@pegasus-retail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, EdgeWorks Support <support@edgeworks.io>
Date: 2028-09-17T11:30:00Z
Subject: Proposed mutual action plan & immediate mitigation — Pegasus Retail

Elena / Ben —

Thanks again for the rapid signal. Attached is a draft mutual action plan and our immediate mitigation plan:

- Immediate (applied): routed /checkout for Pegasus to model-variant-nonstream at 10:45 UTC on 2028-09-16. Client teams will see streaming disabled for checkout only. This reduced error rate from 6.8% to 0.4% in our preliminary window.
- Near-term (this week): EdgeWorks will deploy a gateway buffering patch (ETA 6–8 hours after approval) to reduce header fragmentation.
- Patch release (resolution): Redwood will ship parser robustness patch v1.12.4. Target deploy to runtime fleet: 2028-09-19 02:00 UTC with a staged canary; full rollout by 2028-09-19 10:00 UTC pending regression signal.
- Compensation: draft credit equal to 30% of this week's affected usage; Marissa will follow up with a formal credit note.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_pegasus.docx, patch-release-notes-v1.12.4.pdf

Can we confirm a 30-minute call today at 15:00 UTC to sign off on the MAP and approve the EdgeWorks gateway patch window?

Regards,
Sean
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@pegasus-retail.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Zhao <ben.zhao@pegasus-retail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-09-17T12:02:18Z
Subject: Re: Proposed mutual action plan & immediate mitigation — Pegasus Retail

Sean —

Appreciate the clear plan and fast action. The routing change materially reduced impact during our mid-day window; thank you. We approve the MAP and the EdgeWorks patch window — please proceed. We accept the proposed credit and will expect formal confirmation via invoice credit.

One ask for the long term: please include an integration checklist for customers that highlights streaming edge cases (header fragmentation, keepalive tuning) so we can harden future rollouts.

Elena
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Morales <elena.morales@pegasus-retail.com>
Cc: EdgeWorks Support <support@edgeworks.io>
Date: 2028-09-19T17:45:00Z
Subject: Patch deployed to canary — runtime parser fix v1.12.4

Update for the thread: patch v1.12.4 (parser robustness) was deployed to the canary cluster at 2028-09-19T02:10 UTC and to full fleet by 2028-09-19T09:50 UTC after green metrics.

Observations:
- Canary: no parser back-off reproductions in the lab harness.
- Post-rollout: Pegasus account has remained on model-variant-nonstream for checkout until EdgeWorks confirm buffer patch. We've seen sustained error rate <0.2% and p99 back to baseline.
- Next steps: 1) Add a short integration checklist for streaming clients (Grace to own), 2) Run a cross-org postmortem (Priyom / Runtime; Marissa / CS) and share an action list.

Attachments: postdeploy-smoke-screenshots.zip (ops evidence)

Closing note: thank you for the quick collaboration — will follow with the postmortem and the formal credit documentation.

Priyom
